newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Maputo allows export earnings in foreign exchange.
newsitem.headline: Maputo allows export earnings in foreign exchange.

text.p: Mozambique's central bank announced on Saturday that exporters could now keep their earnings in foreign exchange instead of local currency.
"Exporters of goods and services may retain in foreign exchange 100 percent of export receipts in authorised lending institutions," the Bank of Mozambique statement said.
Previously only a percentage of earnings was allowed to be held in foreign currency. The decree took effect on January 2, the statement said.
The Mozambican currency, the Metical, is not convertible but has been relatively stable against the U.S. dollar over the last year, with a devaluation of about 20 percent.
